name: Unique Ladies
storyline:
Step into the shoes of Laura Renaldi, a charming sales manager for a prestigious Italian Fine Food Supplier based in London, as she embarks on a whirlwind trip to an exclusive hospitality conference in Stockholm, Sweden.

In the midst of business deals and elegant galas, Laura will cross paths with captivating, eccentric, and stunning women. Will one of them turn out to be the love of her life? Or will her journey be one of personal discovery and unforgettable moments?
summary: Love, fine food, and romance await! Join Laura Renaldi, a charming sales manager, on a whirlwind trip to an exclusive hospitality conference in Stockholm. Amidst galas and business deals, she’ll meet stunning women—will one be her true love? A heartwarming Yuri VN with humour, jazz, and romance!
